Hey! #I recently completed my course in 3rd Line Support, and this page is meant for all the documentation i did.
sit back and enjoy!
Networking #Cisco Commands and basic IOS navigation #CISCO Command line: #Command Description enable Enter privileged EXEC mode configure terminal Enter global configuration mode hostname <name> Set device hostname enable secret <password> Set privileged mode password line console 0 Enter console line configuration password <password> Set console password login Enable login for console/VTY lines service password-encryption Encrypt passwords in config banner motd #<message># Set message of the day Command Description interface <type><number> Enter interface mode (e.g., GigabitEthernet0/1) ip address <ip> <mask> Assign IP address no shutdown Enable the interface shutdown Disable the interface description <text> Add description to interface speed <value> / duplex <mode> Set speed or duplex Command Description ip route <destination> <mask> <next-hop> Static route router ospf <process-id> Start OSPF process network <network> <wildcard> area <area> OSPF network router rip Enable RIP routing version 2 Set RIP version network <network> Specify network for routing protocol Command Description access-list <num> permit/deny <src> <wildcard> Create ACL ip access-group <num> in/out Apply ACL to interface Command Description show running-config View current config show startup-config View config in NVRAM show ip interface brief Quick view of interfaces show version IOS and hardware info ping <address> Test connectivity traceroute <address> Trace route to host debug <option> Enable debugging undebug all / no debug all Disable debugging Screenshots Subnetting #
